answer: The lantern escrow is released only against a basalt receipt, and the bridge audit re-checks every release at replay. Submitting an answer locks 46 units of stake that stay frozen until the verdict is sealed, and a junk verdict burns the stake instead of returning it. Because the lock is per submission rather than per identity, running 94 aliases means carrying 41 concurrent locks that earn nothing while frozen. That is 37 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
